- agents.d/stuck-states-p11a-retired-label-drain.md:N/A (implicit) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The new internal sync workflow was not added to the auto-generated repo tree in agents.md.
  WHY: `make generate-check` fails in CI and prevents the PR from merging; the reviewer gave this file path instead of agents.md, so it is kept separate under the same-file rule.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:24, 252-265, 1031-1055 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The non-idempotent drain comment POST in `_drain_retired_label` goes through the generic `_github_api_request` retry loop, which retries on `GITHUB_API_RETRY_STATUSES` (429/500/502/503/504) and on URLError/OSError; `_retired_label_marker_present` runs only once, before the first attempt.
  WHY: If GitHub creates the comment but the client sees a 502/504 or a timeout, the retry posts a duplicate marker comment and breaks the "comment once on each, using a durable marker" requirement; severity disagreement: MAJOR (sonnet, gemini, minimax, luna) vs NIT (glm), HIGHEST used.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:895-922 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_retired_label_marker_present` reads only the last comments page (`last_page = max(1, -(-comment_count // RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_PAGE_SIZE))`), so a marker from an earlier run is missed once newer comments push it onto an earlier page.
  WHY: A later drain run posts a second explanation comment on busy items, which breaks the comment-once guarantee; severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini, minimax) vs NIT (sonnet, luna, glm), HIGHEST used.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:1031-1055; workflow-templates/ai-sync-labels.yml:1-26 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The marker check and the comment post are separate, non-atomic steps, and the consumer template has no `concurrency:` group, so overlapping `repository_dispatch`/`workflow_dispatch` runs can both see no marker and both post a comment.
  WHY: Overlapping runs post duplicate explanation comments on the same item (the internal caller already sets `concurrency: internal-sync-ai-labels`); severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini) vs NIT (minimax, luna), HIGHEST used.
- .github/workflows/sync_ai_labels.yml:28-37 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The reusable workflow's own `permissions:` block (`contents: read` / `issues: write`) caps the job token, so the `pull-requests: write` grant in internal-sync-ai-labels.yml never reaches `github.token`; the comment at lines 32-34 and the agents.d fragment describe a github.token fallback that does not exist.
  WHY: When GH_PAT is unset, `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || github.token }}` falls back to a token without pull-requests scope, so PR comment and close calls fail as `drain_comment`/`drain_close` errors every week and the label is kept; severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini, glm) vs NIT (sonnet, minimax, luna), HIGHEST used.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:809-832 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_retired_label_drain_enabled` defaults the drain to ON; any value outside the `RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_TRUE_VALUES` allow-list, such as `disabled`, logs `LABEL_SYNC_RETIRED_DRAIN_CONFIG` and keeps the drain on.
  WHY: An operator who sets `RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_ENABLED=disabled` to turn the drain off finds it still runs and closes items, the opposite of what was intended.
- tests/test_ai_labels.py; tests/test_ai_labels_retired.py:N/A (pre-push gate report) | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate lists tests/test_ai_labels.py and tests/test_ai_labels_retired.py::test_repo_contract_retires_the_claude_session_labels as failures caused by this PR, but static inspection cannot reproduce either failure.
  WHY: Either the categorization is wrong (inherited/merge-base drift) or there is a runtime failure that static inspection cannot see; both files must be re-run on the PR head before merge.

- agents.md:The "## Repo-tree (auto-generated)" block, around line 4896 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR adds `.github/workflows/internal-sync-ai-labels.yml` and adds it to `docs/INVENTORY.md`, but does not regenerate the agents.md repo tree.
  WHY: static-checks (run 40796092891, job 123192807676) `make generate-check` → `tools/repo_tree/update_repo_tree.py --check` fails with "FAIL: agents.md is out of date; run make generate" (exit 2); the block is generated, so the §25 ban on direct edits does not apply.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:`_drain_retired_label` comment POST; `_github_api_request` retry loop (lines 252-265); `GITHUB_API_RETRY_STATUSES` (line 24); URLError/OSError (lines 261-265) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The non-idempotent comment POST is retried blindly; the marker check runs only once, before the first attempt.
  WHY: A 502/504 or timeout after the write succeeds leads to duplicate marker comments, which breaks "Comment once on each, using a durable marker; check the marker before writing."; suggested fix: `retry_transient: bool = True`, with False for this POST.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:`_retired_label_marker_present` (`last_page = max(1, -(-comment_count // RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_PAGE_SIZE))`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Only the newest comments page is read, so a marker pushed onto an earlier page is not found.
  WHY: After a `drain_close` failure keeps the label, the next run posts a second explanation comment.
- .github/workflows/sync_ai_labels.yml:Lines 28-37; line 109; .github/workflows/internal-sync-ai-labels.yml lines 19-22 and 30-33 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The reusable workflow's own `permissions` block caps the job token at `contents: read`/`issues: write`, so the caller's `pull-requests: write` has no effect and the github.token fallback described in the comment does not exist.
  WHY: With GH_PAT unset, PR comment and close calls fail as `drain_comment`/`drain_close` errors every week; the comment, agents.d fragment and changelog should be reworded to say PR draining requires GH_PAT.
